01
Why a threshold fails
A single cut-off cannot separate 38 °C at 15 % humidity with 70 km/h wind from 42 °C in saturated still air. The first case is the dangerous one, and a temperature-only rule ranks it safe. Spread is non-linear in the same way: dry wind at moderate temperature ignites faster than a hot, humid afternoon.

02
Linguistic variables
Four inputs, four sets each — 16 in total. Trapezoids close the outer sets, so a reading past the sensor range saturates instead of running off the universe.
VarUniverseSets
T0–50 °Clow · moderate · high · extreme
RH0–100 %very low · low · moderate · high
WS0–100 km/hcalm · moderate · high · severe
FD0–100 %wet · moderate · dry · critical
Membership functions — temperature and fuel dryness shown; humidity and wind use the same four-set template. Outputs: fire risk index (4 sets), throttle urgency (3).
03
Rule base
4 inputs × 4 sets = 256 antecedent combinations, curated down to the 10 that are physically meaningful. any means the rule does not constrain that variable; min for AND, max for aggregation.
RuleTRHWSFDRisk
R1anyHighanyWetLow
R2LowModerateanyanyLow
R3ModerateanyanyModerateModerate
R4ModerateanyHighDryHigh
R5HighLowanyanyHigh
R6HighanySevereanyExtreme
R7ExtremeVery LowanyanyExtreme
R8anyanyHighCriticalExtreme
R9ExtremeanyanyCriticalExtreme
R10anyHighCalmanyLow
Firing strength α = min(µ of each antecedent); aggregated output µagg(y) = max over rules.
04
Defuzzification
y* = ∫ y · µagg(y) dy / ∫ µagg(y) dy
Cost of the defuzzification step alone, median of 20,000 calls per scenario. The three methods do not separate on speed; they separate on continuity.
MethodCostSmoothnessVerdict
Centroid (COG)2.5 µscontinuousselected
Bisector11.5–12.0 µscontinuousviable
Mean of max (MOM)2.7–2.9 µsstep jumpsrejected
MOM returns the mean of the aggregated set's maxima, so crossing a boundary jumps the output between peaks — a torque step on a 250 g airframe. Centroid integrates the whole area, so its output is continuous in the input.

07
Conclusion
Four inputs, ten auditable rules and a closed loop inside Isaac Sim; 8/8 unit tests pass. Limitation: simulation only, rule base expert-tuned, edge latency projected rather than measured. Next: ANFIS tuning, multi-UAV mesh, PX4 and Matrice 300 field trials.
Impact. Early thermal detection within the first 15–30 minutes of ignition catches fire before crown spread (SDG 13.1) and protects forest habitat (SDG 15.2); exact coordinates cut containment time, water use and crew exposure.
